svg.aria-label: Production architecture of a multi-tenant chatbot SaaS on GKE including RAG pipeline, CI/CD and platform services
svg.text: Production architecture · Google Kubernetes Engine · namespace-isolated tenancy · retrieval-augmented generation
Wildcard record resolves every tenant subdomain
Cloud load balancer → Nginx ingress controller
Host header routes to the tenant namespace
Chart per service, values per tenant
Mirror, scaled to zero when idle
Regional · autoscaled node pools · one namespace per tenant
Central control plane, shared by every tenant
One fully isolated stack per client · replicated for every tenant · default-deny network policy · state on regional persistent volumes
default-pool · pool-master · pool-tenants-v2 (nodeSelector pinned, cluster autoscaler 2–4 nodes)
Liveness and readiness probes · resource requests and limits · rolling updates · graceful termination
